title: Hold a manufacturer licence to make excisable goods
what: Making excisable goods (beer, spirits, tobacco and fuel) needs a manufacturer licence from the ATO for the premises, with duty paid or deferred under the Act.

sources.title: Excise Act 1901
sources.quote: (1) A person who does not hold a manufacturer licence must not intentionally manufacture excisable goods knowing, or being reckless as to whether, the goods are excisable goods.
